"""
Project Title: Hypernetwork-Based Continual Learner for Permuted MNIST (ai-ml-ds-HyperContPermMNIST2025)
File Name: hypernetwork_continual_permuted_mnist.py

Short Description:
Implements a hypernetwork in Keras that generates weights for a small MLP classifier conditioned on a task embedding.
Trains on sequential Permuted MNIST tasks to demonstrate continual learning without catastrophic forgetting.
"""

import os  # type: ignore
import datetime  # type: ignore
import numpy as np  # type: ignore
import tensorflow as tf  # type: ignore
from tensorflow.keras import layers, Model, Input  # type: ignore
from tensorflow.keras.datasets import mnist  # type: ignore

# ----------------------------
# 1. Hyperparameters & Setup
# ----------------------------
SEED: int = 123
np.random.seed(SEED); tf.random.set_seed(SEED)
NUM_TASKS: int = 5            # type: int = number of permuted MNIST tasks
EMB_DIM: int = 16             # type: int = task embedding dimension
HYP_HIDDEN: int = 128         # type: int = hypernetwork hidden size
BASE_HIDDEN: int = 64         # type: int = base MLP hidden size
INPUT_DIM: int = 28*28        # type: int = flattened MNIST input
NUM_CLASSES: int = 10         # type: int = output classes
BATCH_SIZE: int = 256         # type: int = batch size
EPOCHS_PER_TASK: int = 3      # type: int = epochs per task
LR: float = 1e-3             # type: float = learning rate
LOG_DIR: str = "./hyper_cont_logs/" + datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
os.makedirs(LOG_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# ----------------------------
# 2. Prepare Permuted MNIST Tasks
# ----------------------------
(x_train_all, y_train_all), (x_test_all, y_test_all) = mnist.load_data()
x_train_all = x_train_all.reshape(-1, INPUT_DIM).astype("float32") / 255.0
x_test_all  = x_test_all.reshape(-1, INPUT_DIM).astype("float32") / 255.0

permutations = [np.random.RandomState(SEED+i).permutation(INPUT_DIM) for i in range(NUM_TASKS)]
train_tasks = []
test_tasks = []
for perm in permutations:
    x_tr = x_train_all[:,perm]
    x_te = x_test_all[:,perm]
    train_tasks.append((x_tr, y_train_all))
    test_tasks.append((x_te, y_test_all))

# ----------------------------
# 3. Hypernetwork Definition
# ----------------------------
class HyperNetwork(Model):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.embed = layers.Embedding(NUM_TASKS, EMB_DIM)
        self.d1 = layers.Dense(HYP_HIDDEN, activation="relu")
        # generate weights for two-layer MLP: [IN->H], [H->C] + biases
        self.w1 = layers.Dense(INPUT_DIM * BASE_HIDDEN)
        self.b1 = layers.Dense(BASE_HIDDEN)
        self.w2 = layers.Dense(BASE_HIDDEN * NUM_CLASSES)
        self.b2 = layers.Dense(NUM_CLASSES)
    def call(self, task_id: tf.Tensor):
        e: tf.Tensor = self.embed(task_id)            # (batch, EMB_DIM)
        h: tf.Tensor = self.d1(e)                     # (batch, HYP_HIDDEN)
        w1_flat: tf.Tensor = self.w1(h)               # (batch, IN*H)
        b1: tf.Tensor      = self.b1(h)               # (batch, H)
        w2_flat: tf.Tensor = self.w2(h)               # (batch, H*C)
        b2: tf.Tensor      = self.b2(h)               # (batch, C)
        return w1_flat, b1, w2_flat, b2

hypernet = HyperNetwork()

# ----------------------------
# 4. Base MLP Forward Using Generated Weights
# ----------------------------
@tf.function
def base_forward(x: tf.Tensor, weights: tuple):
    w1_flat, b1, w2_flat, b2 = weights
    batch = tf.shape(x)[0]
    w1 = tf.reshape(w1_flat, (batch, INPUT_DIM, BASE_HIDDEN))
    w2 = tf.reshape(w2_flat, (batch, BASE_HIDDEN, NUM_CLASSES))
    # per-sample matmul via batch_dot
    h1 = tf.nn.relu(tf.einsum('bi,bij->bj', x, w1) + b1)
    logits = tf.einsum('bi,bij->bj', h1, w2) + b2
    return logits

# ----------------------------
# 5. Training Loop Across Tasks
# ----------------------------
opt = tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(LR)
loss_fn = tf.keras.losses.SparseCategoricalCrossentropy(from_logits=True)
acc_metric = tf.keras.metrics.SparseCategoricalAccuracy()

for task_id in range(NUM_TASKS):
    x_tr, y_tr = train_tasks[task_id]
    ds = tf.data.Dataset.from_tensor_slices((x_tr, y_tr)).shuffle(10000, seed=SEED).batch(BATCH_SIZE)
    for epoch in range(1, EPOCHS_PER_TASK+1):
        acc_metric.reset_states()
        for x_batch, y_batch in ds:
            t_ids: tf.Tensor = tf.fill((tf.shape(x_batch)[0],), task_id)
            with tf.GradientTape() as tape:
                weights = hypernet(t_ids)
                logits = base_forward(x_batch, weights)
                loss = loss_fn(y_batch, logits)
            grads = tape.gradient(loss, hypernet.trainable_variables)
            opt.apply_gradients(zip(grads, hypernet.trainable_variables))
            acc_metric.update_state(y_batch, logits)
        tf.print(f"Task {task_id} Epoch {epoch}: Loss={loss:.4f}, Acc={acc_metric.result():.4f}")

# ----------------------------
# 6. Example Inference Use Cases
# ----------------------------
def evaluate_task(task_id: int, n: int = 1000):
    x_te, y_te = test_tasks[task_id]
    x_samp: tf.Tensor = x_te[:n]
    y_samp: tf.Tensor = y_te[:n]
    t_ids: tf.Tensor = tf.fill((n,), task_id)
    weights = hypernet(t_ids)
    logits = base_forward(x_samp, weights)
    preds = tf.argmax(logits, axis=1)
    acc = tf.reduce_mean(tf.cast(preds == y_samp, tf.float32))
    tf.print(f"Eval Task {task_id}: Accuracy={acc:.4f}")

# Evaluate first 3 tasks
evaluate_task(0)
evaluate_task(1)
evaluate_task(2)

Key Learnings & Research Areas:

  • Hypernetworks: generating weights conditioned on task embeddings for continual learning.
  • Continual Learning on Permuted MNIST tasks without replay or regularization.
  • Techniques: task embeddings, per-sample weight generation, batch-einsum for dynamic networks.

This pushes Keras usage deep into meta‑modeling and continual adaptation—an advanced, unique architecture for lifelong learning.
